title: THE GLANCE: Love at First Sight BGM (original score)
description:
The very first time he sees her. A curious flute glance on a bright Kalyani colour grows, without a single break, into a happy, bouncing first-love groove on tabla, veena and violins.

For fans of love-at-first-sight scenes, happy romantic BGM, South Indian love songs and flute themes. Headphones on.

Music: The Glance, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
